title: Welcome to Noad
about: Noad is a node-based brainstorming canvas. Jot ideas down as Nodes, connect related ideas with Synapses, and drop in traced images — then pan, zoom, and freely rearrange everything on an infinite canvas.

sections.heading: Nodes
sections.body: A Node is a resizable sticky note with a title and body text. Pick the Node tool and click (or click-drag) on the canvas to place one, then double-click it to start typing. Drag its edges or corners to resize it, and drag its body to move it.

sections.heading: Synapses
sections.body: A Synapse is a connection between two Nodes. Pick the Synapse tool (or just drag from a Node's blue port) and drop it on another Node's port to link them. Double-click a synapse to add a bend point, and drag its arrowheads or bends to reshape the path.

sections.heading: Images
sections.body: Use the Image button on the toolbar to import an image and convert it to an SVG image, then drop it onto the canvas like any other element.

sections.heading: Properties & Styling
sections.body: Select a Node, Synapse, or Image to edit its properties in the panel on the right. Use the top and left panels to change canvas-wide defaults — colors, fonts, borders, and more.

shortcuts.description: Nudge the selection, or pan the canvas if nothing is selected
Jump the selection (or pan faster) in larger steps
Add or remove a Node/Image from the selection
Zoom the canvas, or adjust a hovered number field
Pan the canvas, or scrub-adjust a hovered number field
Return to the Select tool; press twice to close open panels
